ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export`. - **ANC(a,b)** is `git merge-base --is-ancestor a b`. - **RB(p)** is the coordinated read-back: `git -C worktree list --porcelain` must print `worktree

`, and `git -C

branch --show-current` must print `spec-export`. - **Inventory** is the `Preserved created legs:` list, with lines in the form ` `. - Intent is carried beside the gate as `Intent carried from the command: preserve receipts`. --- ## A - Two legs, through the gate **Admission and classification** 1. `gh pr view 42 --json number,url,state,isDraft,title,body,headRefName,headRefOid,headRepository,isCrossRepository,baseRefName` returns OPEN, not a fork. Base repository acme/widget equals origin acme/widget. 2. ROOT is `/work/widget`. The submodule guard returns nothing. 3. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin main spec-export` runs. 4. `BASE_SHA=5555555555555555555555555555555555555555`. 5. `git -C /work/widget diff --name-status 5555555555555555555555555555555555555555...1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` returns `A doc/specs/export.md` only, so the shape passes. 6. `git show 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111:doc/specs/export.md` shows `**Engine:** deferred` before the first `## `, so the marker passes. 7. The same `git show` output is used to count `### Leg:` blocks before home provisioning: **2** (acme/widget, acme/helper). This sets coordinated marked context N>1. 8. Force `SYNC=merge`. 9. Skip ticket binding, context-builder, gather and every thread query. **Home provisioning (pr-head, one-element array)** 1. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` runs. The 1111 commit is reachable, and `origin/spec-export` = 1111. 2. None of the ordered stops apply. There is no local branch and no recovery. 3. The recorded `create:` contains `-b`, so the built-in path runs: `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export" spec-export` (existing-branch DWIM). 4. HEAD equals 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. 5. `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` runs. 6. `git -C H merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` produces 8888888888888888888888888888888888888888. 7. ANC(1111111111111111111111111111111111111111, HEAD) exits 0. The recorded acme/helper is matched to the IDENTITY of `https://github.com/acme/helper.git` before any probe. PATH is `/work/helper`. 3. `/work/helper` is a checkout. `git -C /work/helper config --get remote.origin.url` returns acme/helper. 4. Explicit comparison: canonical `/work/helper` ≠ canonical `/work/widget`. **Preflight (all companions, before any provisioning)** 1. `git -C /work/helper fetch origin` runs. LS(/work/helper) exits 0, and `origin/spec-export` = 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. 2. Helper's own `.pi/settings.json` and overrides are read by file. The resolved `home:` and `create:` equal the recorded values, so there is no drift. The repeated LS returns exit 0. 2. `ORIGINAL_HEAD=2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. 3. `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` returns `main`. BASE_SHA is 5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. 4. No local branch exists, so the built-in DWIM add runs and the skip line is reported. 5. HEAD equals 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. 6. The base merge produces 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444. 7. ANC(2222222222222222222222222222222222222222, HEAD) exits 0. RB(Hp) passes. ``` Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export Branch: spec-export Base SHA: 5555555 merge: 4444444 create: override skipped (contains -b) ``` **Gate** 1. `AUDIT_SHA=$(git -C H log -1 --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- doc/specs/export.md)` returns 6666666666666666666666666666666666666666. 2. `git -C H show -s --format=%b 6666666666666666666666666666666666666666` shows all three audit labels, so the audit is recognized. 3. The initial spec commit is skipped. 4. `SUMMARY_PATH=$(mktemp …)` runs. spec-summarizer is dispatched file-only. `Read` is the last content-producing call. Then `rm "$SUMMARY_PATH"` runs. ``` gauntlet: gate=brainstorming/user-review-gate Retried exports retain receipts. Spec written and committed to widget/doc/specs/export.md (worktree: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export). Scope cuts: none Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected Intent carried from the command: preserve receipts 1 - approve: … 2 - approve, auto-apply amends: … 3 - show council dispositions: … 4 - approve, loop engine (experimental): … allowance 4 per row. 5 - approve, loop engine, auto-apply amends: … allowance 4 per row. Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists ``` The full ready reports are rendered home first, then helper, as shown above. A reply of `3` prints the pinned body from 6666, not HEAD. --- ## B - Three legs, codec's remote branch deleted 1. Home is provisioned as in A. 2. Settlement matches helper and codec. Helper preflight passes as in A. 3. `git -C /work/codec fetch origin` succeeds. 4. LS(/work/codec) returns **exit 2**, with no output. The stale `origin/spec-export` (3333333333333333333333333333333333333333) is ignored. 5. The stop happens before any companion add, local-ref update or merge. Helper is not provisioned. ``` origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec ``` **Recovery check** The check is `git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md`. No checkout or modification of the primary takes place. - **(1)** The log prints 7777777777777777777777777777777777777777. The ending is: offer `git push -u origin spec-export` from `/work/codec`, then rerun `brainstorming #42`. - **(2) and (3)** The log prints nothing. The ending is: `no local branch on this machine holds the leg file; restore origin/spec-export from a clone that still has it and rerun brainstorming #42; nothing is regenerated`. No push is offered. Every ending is followed by: ``` Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export ``` **Exit 128 (independent)** This is a command failure, not absence: ``` acme/codec: git -C /work/codec ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export failed: fatal: unable to access origin ``` The same inventory follows. No recovery ending is offered. --- ## C - Membership stops **No codec declaration at BASE_SHA** The BASE_SHA overrides lack the codec line. The worktree copy is not authoritative. ``` leg acme/codec matches no sibling declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md ``` There is no companion write, and the home inventory follows. **Helper validation stops (independent)** Each stop is the legs validation stop, which names the declaration line: - `- sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git: /work/helper is missing` - `…: stored origin acme/other is not acme/helper` - `…: /work/helper resolves to home /work/widget` (canonical equality, checked before any companion provisioning) If the last selected checkout is missing, preflight fails before provisioning. No helper tree is created or synced. --- ## D - Contract drift and a malformed block **Drift stops (independent cases)** These come from preflight, before provisioning, with no silent choice: ``` contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/, resolved trees/; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 contract drift for acme/helper: recorded create: git worktree add -b , resolved workspace add ; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 ``` **Repair** The repair is a user-approved amendment through home-plus-companion reconciliation: 1. Rewrite the `### Leg: acme/helper` block in home `doc/specs/export.md`. 2. Rewrite the helper companion `doc/specs/export.md` block verbatim. 3. Commit each through its own `git -C`. 4. The amendment is not complete until both files agree. Then rerun. **Malformed third block (independent)** ``` ### Leg: acme/codec is malformed: missing ``` There is no fallback to ordinary sibling discovery. ``` Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export ``` --- ## E - Partial provisioning, recovery and race **Codec checked out at another path** 1. Home merges to 8888888 and helper is ready. 2. Codec has a recorded `home:`, so the another-path stop applies: ``` acme/codec: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first. Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` Nothing is removed. **Rerun: home recovery** 1. The local tip is 8888888888888888888888888888888888888888, which is not 1111. 2. There is no active rebase. 3. ANC(1111111111111111111111111111111111111111, refs/heads/spec-export) exits 0. 4. `git -C /work/widget log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/spec-export..refs/heads/spec-export` returns one entry: `8888… 1111… 5555…`. 5. ANC(5555555555555555555555555555555555555555, origin/main) exits 0, and the tree is clean. 6. The tree is reused unchanged. HEAD equals 8888888888888888888888888888888888888888. 7. The base merge reports `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`. 8. The read-back adds `Base sync recovered: 8888888`. 9. There is no reset, no update-ref and no `-b`. The pre-rework ref is preserved. The member-merge and rework-base checks are bypassed. **Helper merge unresolved (independent)** 1. The helper fails, then `git -C Hp merge --abort` runs. The outcome is recorded as `merge: unresolved - doc/specs/old.md`. ``` base merge unresolved for acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42 Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 2. The user merges by hand, producing 9999999999999999999999999999999999999999. 3. On rerun, the walk returns `9999… 2222… 5555…`. The second parent, 5555, is an ancestor of `origin/main`, and the tree is clean. 4. The tree is reused. The read-back adds `Base sync recovered: 9999999` and reports `merge: no-op`. There is no reset. **Alternative helper tip aaaa…** 1. The walk returns a one-parent entry, so the proof fails. 2. ANC(refs/heads/spec-export, origin/spec-export) exits 1. ``` acme/helper: local branch spec-export is at aaaaaaa, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (2222222); companion needs the published branch head. ``` The home and helper inventory follows. There is no reset. **Race** 1. Preflight passed and helper was provisioned. 2. In codec companion mode, `git -C /work/codec fetch origin` succeeds. The stale ref still resolves to 3333. 3. The backstop LS(/work/codec) returns exit 2. 4. The stop is `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec`. 5. The file-scoped log prints nothing, which is observation (2), so the restore ending is used. 6. The home and helper inventory follows. There are no codec writes. If the lookup instead returns exit 128, the result is the B command-failure stop with the home and helper inventory. --- ## G - Script-placed helper **Contract check** 1. The block has no `home:` line. The recorded `create:` is `script/worktree create --branch `. 2. In the primary, there is no keyed contract and no native tool. Step 1b discovers `script/worktree`. 3. Rendered portably, the discovered template equals the recorded `create:`, so there is no drift. The `home:` comparison is skipped. **Reuse case** 1. The Locate a leg tree lookup runs `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain`. Its linked block on `refs/heads/spec-export` is `/work/helper-trees/export`. 2. The identity checks pass: the path exists, its toplevel equals its realpath, it differs from the primary, and its common directory matches. 3. The tree is reused. The another-path stop is bypassed. 4. The tree is clean, so `git -C /work/helper-trees/export merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` runs. HEAD equals 2222. 5. The base sync and RB pass. **No-tree case** 1. The lookup returns `no worktree holds spec-export`. 2. The script source is read before any write. The source-clean check passes. There is no local branch, so no update-ref is needed. 3. From `/work/helper`, `script/worktree create 'spec-export' --branch 'spec-export'` runs. 4. Located by branch, the new tree is `/work/helper-trees/export`. HEAD equals 2222. 5. The base sync and RB pass. **Unsupported script** The stop happens before any ref write or add, with no built-in fallback: ``` cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export ``` **Recorded-home case** ``` contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/, resolved absent; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 ``` The `home:` line is dropped only by a user-approved amendment. That amendment removes it from both the home block and the helper companion file, and each is committed through its own `git -C`. Nothing is rewritten automatically. --- ## F - Gate replies (from A) **Reply 1** 1. Read Standing grants and decode the reply. The value is `none`. 2. Edit only the home spec: - `**Amend-grant:** none` - `**Engine:** waves`, replacing `deferred` - `**PR:** acme/widget#42`, directly below Engine 3. Stage with `git -C H add -- doc/specs/export.md`. 4. Make a new commit, `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`, with no `--amend`. 5. Verify all three fields with `git -C H show HEAD:doc/specs/export.md`. 6. Call `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "brainstorm" })`, then `/skill:writing-plans`. 7. The helper companion file is untouched. **Change request (independent)** 1. Revise the home shared Design to "Keep receipts with pending status". 2. Make a new home commit without the old audit body. 3. Rewrite the helper companion `## Decisions` and commit it through `git -C Hp`. Both files must agree before continuing. 4. Re-dispatch the summarizer with a fresh `mktemp` path, then re-present the gate. 5. No second council runs, and no approval is inferred. **Throughout F** - Audit pinning and grant decoding stay unchanged. - There are no companion PR fields, no pre-rework refs, no MEMBER_HEADS entries and no thread fetches. - There is no handoff or resume route.

## Shared command and read legend

These are prescribed actions narrated from the fixed observations, not live calls. Each checkpoint is independent.

- **R(path):** required `read` at the absolute `skills/` resource path. No reference contents are reconstructed. An unreadable required resource blocks that stage.
- **Primary discovery:** read the first-found overrides and own settings; companion settings are read by file, never through session `gauntlet_setting`.
- **Live check(P):** `git -C P ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export`.
- **Preserve:** remove no worktree or branch; retain the spec and receipt contract.

## A — Two-leg admission, settlement, and re-gate

1. **Admission/classification reads:** R(`/skills/brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`), R(`/skills/brainstorming/reference/spec-pr.md`), R(`/skills/brainstorming/reference/legs.md`), and R(`/skills/using-git-worktrees/reference/pr-head.md`), using the installation’s absolute `skills/` prefix.
2. Admit the single OPEN, non-fork home PR. Fetch its base/head, inspect the pinned diff, and read `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111:doc/specs/export.md`. Observe one added spec, the exact deferred header marker, and **two original-head Leg blocks before home provisioning**. Select coordinated marked re-gating and merge sync.
3. Provision home from the existing remote branch using:
   `git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export`.
   The creator contains `-b`, so skip it. Verify the original head, merge the fetched base, and observe:
   ```text
   Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   Base: spec-export @ 1111111
   PR: acme/widget#42
   Pre-rework head: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
   Base SHA: 5555555
   create: override skipped (contains -b)
   merge: 8888888
   ```
4. Read the committed Legs in order. Read home’s authoritative `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` at `BASE_SHA`; use its sibling parser. Match `acme/helper` before probing. Canonical `/work/helper` differs explicitly from canonical `/work/widget`. Validate checkout and stored origin.
5. Preflight **every companion before provisioning any companion**: fetch origin, perform Live check(`/work/helper`), resolve its own settings/overrides, and compare the recorded portable contract. All pass.
6. Invoke using-git-worktrees with explicit `ROOT=/work/helper`, `BRANCH=spec-export`, `REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`. Repeat fetch and live existence checks. Skip the `-b` creator and use existing-branch DWIM:
   `git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export`.
   Verify head/branch/path, merge its fetched base, and observe:
   ```text
   Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   Base: spec-export @ 2222222
   Base SHA: 5555555
   create: override skipped (contains -b)
   merge: 4444444
   ```
7. **Independent `-B` delta:** use the same built-in existing-branch provisioning and the same prescribed skip report, `create: override skipped (contains -b)`.
8. Skip gathering, questionary, lint, council, and thread queries. Pin audit commit `6666666666666666666666666666666666666666`. Dispatch the spec-only summarizer to a fresh external temporary path; retain the observed allowance 4. Read its output last before rendering, then clean up the temporary file. Gate inventory is home first, helper second, with both complete reports above.
9. Render:
   ```text
   gauntlet: gate=brainstorming/user-review-gate
   Retried exports retain receipts.

   Spec: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export/doc/specs/export.md
   Scope cuts: none

   Drafted acceptance criteria (approval ratifies):
   - [ ] Repeated exports return the original receipt
     in-scope

   Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected

   1 - approve: proceed to planning; amendments retain review.
   2 - approve, auto-apply amends: proceed to planning with the amendment grant.
   3 - show council dispositions: print the pinned audit and re-present; not approval.
   4 - approve, loop engine (experimental): allowance 4 per row; amendments retain review.
   5 - approve, loop engine, auto-apply amends: allowance 4 per row.
   Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists
   ```
   No new initial spec commit occurs on this marked re-gate.

## B — Deleted last remote versus transport failure

1. Count three original-head blocks; provision home. Settle and preflight all companions before any companion add, local-ref update, or merge.
2. Codec’s successful plain fetch leaves a stale tracking ref. Live check(`/work/codec`) exits 2, empty:
   ```text
   origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec
   ```
3. Before selecting recovery, run:
   `git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md`.
   Never check out the primary.
   - **B1:** output `7777777777777777777777777777777777777777`: offer `git push -u origin spec-export` from `/work/codec`, then rerun `brainstorming #42`.
   - **B2:** no branch, empty output:
     ```text
     no local branch on this machine holds the leg file; restore origin/spec-export from a clone that still has it and rerun brainstorming #42; nothing is regenerated
     ```
   - **B3:** unrelated local tip, empty file-scoped history: use exactly B2’s ending; offer no push.
4. Preserve home:
   ```text
   Preserved created legs:
   acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
5. **Independent transport branch:** exit 128 is a command failure, not absence. Stop naming `acme/codec`, the exact live-check command, and:
   ```text
   fatal: unable to access origin
   ```
   Perform no missing-remote recovery.

## C — Authoritative membership failures

1. Read sibling declarations at `BASE_SHA`, not from the home worktree copy. With no codec declaration:
   ```text
   leg acme/codec matches no sibling declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
   ```
2. Independently validate matching selected declarations. Missing `/work/helper`, stored origin `acme/other`, or canonical helper PATH equal to `/work/widget` each stops naming the declaration and observed validation failure.
3. A missing last selected checkout prevents **all** companion creation/sync. Preserve home and print its preserved-leg inventory.

## D — Contract drift and malformed blocks

1. Compare portable values before provisioning:
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/<name>, resolved trees/<name>; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
2. Independent creator drift:
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded create: git worktree add <home> -b <branch>, resolved workspace add <home> <branch>; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
3. Choose neither contract silently. An authorized contract repair reconciles the home block and affected companion file, committing home then companion; completion waits for agreement.
4. Independently, a malformed third block missing repo, branch, or contract stops naming that block. Preserve home; provision no companions.

## E — Partial provisioning, recovery, and races

1. Home merges to `8888888888888888888888888888888888888888`; helper becomes ready. Codec’s recorded-home branch is elsewhere:
   ```text
   branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first.
   Preserved created legs:
   acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
2. Rerun: inspect home’s actual branch tip and clean tree. Its nonempty first-parent walk contains only a two-parent base-sync merge whose second parent is an ancestor of `origin/main`. Reuse unchanged—no reset or update-ref. Report:
   ```text
   Base sync recovered: 8888888
   merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
   ```
3. **Independent helper conflict:** after failed helper resolution and abort:
   ```text
   base merge unresolved for acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
   Print the preserved home/helper inventory; emit no helper ready report.
4. After the user’s merge `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999`, rerun the same ancestry, two-parent, second-parent, and cleanliness proofs. Recover unchanged and report `Base sync recovered: 9999999`.
5. **Unrelated helper tip:** `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` fails recovery:
   ```text
   local branch spec-export is at aaaaaaa, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (2222222); companion needs the published branch head.
   ```
   Preserve it; never reset.
6. **Deletion race:** after all-companion preflight and helper provisioning, codec’s repeated Live check exits 2 despite stale tracking data. Stop before codec writes; run B’s file-scoped recovery check, observing B2. Preserve home/helper.
7. **Independent race transport failure:** exit 128 plus `fatal: unable to access origin` stops as a command error, never as absence.

## G — Script-placed helper

1. Read helper’s own configuration and discover `script/worktree` under Step 1b. Compare the recorded script template, not Step 1a’s built-in default.
2. **Existing tree:** locate by branch; validate `/work/helper-trees/export`, checkout identity/common directory, published head, and cleanliness. Reuse it without another-path rejection.
3. **No tree:** read script source before writes. Its supported existing-branch invocation is:
   `script/worktree create spec-export --branch spec-export`.
   Run from primary, locate by branch, verify branch/head, then sync/report.
4. **Unsupported script:**
   ```text
   cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export
   ```
   Stop before local-ref writes/add; no built-in fallback.
5. **Independent recorded-home drift:**
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/<name>, resolved absent; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
   Only a user-approved amendment drops `home:` from both home block and companion file.

## F — Independent gate actions from A

1. Approval `1`: required amendment-reference read and grant decoding precede writes. Commit home-only as `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`; verify committed `Engine: waves`, `Amend-grant: none`, and `PR: acme/widget#42`. Leave companions untouched; complete brainstorm and invoke writing-plans.
2. Shared Design change: revise to “Keep receipts with pending status”; reconcile and commit the live helper artifact before fresh summarization/re-gating. Infer no second council or approval.

Throughout: no companion PR metadata, pre-rework refs, MEMBER_HEADS, thread fetches, or handoff/resume route.
